strategy.thesis: NTUitive is Nanyang Technological University's innovation & enterprise company: it manages NTU's IP, licenses university research, and runs the NTUitive Gap Fund (proof-of-concept grants up to S$250K) plus the 2025-vintage NTU Seed Fund (co-investing alongside external investors in NTU-affiliated spin-offs). strategy.thesis: NUS Enterprise, the entrepreneurial arm of the National University of Singapore, launched a S$150M Venture Capital Programme (22 Jul 2025): S$50M is allocated to selected VC partners — including 4BIO Capital, 'a specialist life sciences investor focused on advanced therapeutics' — to back NUS-linked deep-tech ventures, while S$100M is an autonomous co-investment fund for NUS-affiliated start-ups. 'Future Pulse' (healthcare) is one of the programme's three innovation tracks alongside deep-tech showcases from the National Graduate Research Innovation Programme (GRIP).
